description: Guess the colors of hundreds of images, cartoons, logos and objects you see every day.    EASY TO PLAY, CHALLENGING TO FINISH!    Guess the colors and advance through multiple levels. Try to guess the the solution for hundreds of different images.    Choose carefully, you have limited tries. You can get more tries by solving the images, waiting a little time, or in the store.    WITH ADVANCED FEATURES    * Worldwide Leaderboard  * Super fast play  * Wide live tile  * Get help through hundreds of hints  * Solve through Stars and Hints  * Portrait and Landscape mode
